cases.commercialization_question: Was the exact Modius Spero offering prescribed/distributed by 2026-09-24, and through what channel?

source_observations.source_claim: FDA De Novo grant DENG for Modius Spero, class II, product code SHX.
Manufacturer projects availability to veterans via U.S. VA from summer 2026 onward.
The independent medical-technology trade report says U.S. veterans now have access to Modius Spero through Department of Veterans Affairs use, following FDA De Novo authorization.
source_observations.evidence_limit: Only the public search/indexed article preview was inspected; full subscriber content and primary VA procurement/dispensing records were not obtained.

source_observations.source_claim: Independent dated article claims the device is now available nationwide with a prescription; includes manufacturer CEO interview.
The current page describes Modius Spero as available through VA and restricted to prescription use.
Current page links July and August 2026 webinar replays and describes VA availability; wording's original posting date is not authenticated.
Professional association lists Modius Spero as a new FDA-authorized device; this supports authorization only.

cases.evidence_assessment: A dated July 2 independent trade report asserts VA access, and a separate September 9 television article asserts nationwide prescription availability. Both predate the Sept 24 world cutoff. Source documents still do not independently establish the exact VA device fulfillment workflow or resolve journalist wording versus manufacturer VA-only channel scope.

observed_disagreement.claim_a: Sep 9 reporter says available nationwide with a prescription
observed_disagreement.claim_b: Manufacturer's undated current page describes VA-only availability
observed_disagreement.logic: Nationwide prescription availability could mean geographically nationwide VA access, overgeneralized press coverage, or a broader channel. July 2 reporting specifically describes VA access; no source here proves general non-VA distribution.

authority_boundary: Source triage and evidence proposal only. A historical published claim, a regulator decision and independently confirmed patient/device distribution are different evidence types. New web-inspected pages lack original response-byte custody; no scientific or human decision follows.
